annotations.title: Trace a figure to its lineage

description: Walk any accrued figure all the way back to where it came from — source row → eligibility → bucket → rate → rule → event chain — for a given transaction. This is how you show an auditor exactly why a number is what it is. Requires a connected Aurgus account.

agreement_id.description: Optional — limit to one agreement; otherwise all agreements that fired on the row.

name: trace
